source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.section: II.B.7.c (p7); IX lifts and dangerous movements (1) (p39); IX.A.1 (p38)
source.quote_free_summary: Pro/Am competitions may offer divisions including THEATRICAL and EXHIBITION; lifts are allowed in the Theatrical, Showdance, Grand Championship and Exhibition/Cabaret dance categories only; every couple must dance all dances except in Exhibition/Cabaret.

requirement: Nothing more than the three statements is recorded. The Rule Book text read does not define what a Pro/Am Theatrical or Pro/Am Exhibition division is beyond these statements, so DanceFlow infers no definition; Studio/Custom 'Pro-Am theatrical' and 'Pro-Am exhibition' are organizer-defined divisions with no lift or dance rules.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: NDCA profile, if the owner decides what these divisions require. The generic Studio/Custom model must not carry it, and it must NOT block eligible Studio/Custom competitions; it belongs to a future body profile.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-23 in the pinned PDF. Exact short phrases: 'PRO/AM competitions may offer any or all of the following divisions' (II.B.7.c, printed p7, listing THEATRICAL; EXHIBITION); 'Lifts are allowed in the Theatrical, Showdance, Grand Championship and Exhibition/Cabaret' (IX, printed p39); 'with the exception of Exhibition/Cabaret, all couples must dance all dances' (IX.A.1, printed p38). The profile's earlier descriptions ('lifts allowed', 'not required to dance all dances') were readings of these statements.
